errors.noGM: A GM must be connected to do this.
errors.socket: Mythic Powers: the GM action {action} failed. See the console for details.
errors.gmOnly: Only the GM can do this.

announce.name: Grant announcement
announce.hint: Who sees the chat card when you grant or enable mythic power. It never goes to players who don't own the character.

gmApproval.name: Require GM approval for mythic feats
gmApproval.hint: Players' mythic feat picks are sent to the GM to approve.

killPrompt.name: Prompt on mythic creature defeat
killPrompt.hint: When a mythic creature drops to 0 HP in combat, suggest 2 Mythic Points for the last blow and 1 for each other mythic character.

regainPrompt.name: Calling daily regain prompts
regainPrompt.hint: Offer 1 Mythic Point on the first critical success each day with a character's Calling actions.

mythicDeath.name: Mythic death rules
mythicDeath.hint: A mythic character who would reach dying 4 gains doomed 1 and stabilizes at 0 HP instead. They die only at doomed 4.

heroPointsMixed.name: Hero Points for non-mythic characters
heroPointsMixed.hint: Mixed play: whenever mythic characters gain Mythic Points from a kill or deed, each other character gains a Hero Point.

lateStartPerSession.name: Late start: feats released per session
lateStartPerSession.hint: How many catch-up mythic feat slots open for a late-start character at each Start Session.

npcResetOnCombat.name: Mythic NPCs: reset Mythic Points at combat start
npcResetOnCombat.hint: When a combat starts, every mythic NPC in it goes back to its maximum Mythic Points.

undyingPrompt.name: Mythic NPCs: Undying Myth prompt
undyingPrompt.hint: When a mythic NPC with Undying Myth and at least 1 Mythic Point drops to 0 HP, ask the GM whether it uses Undying Myth.

defensesPrompt.name: Mythic NPCs: Mythic Defenses prompt
defensesPrompt.hint: When an attack critically hits a creature with Mythic Defenses, ask the GM to have the attack rerolled.
